records.title: OPEC+ agrees to keep November oil output targets steady
records.boundary: November targets steady; August actual output cited is lagged and should not be treated as October actual output.

records.title: Middle East crude oil exports exceed pre-war levels but tanker attacks increase
records.boundary: Kpler shipping estimates and reported attacks; higher traffic does not imply normalized security or costs.

records.title: Iran says Strait of Hormuz will not reopen until conditions are met
records.boundary: Public negotiating position; does not mean zero commercial transits.

records.title: Saudi Arabia unexpectedly cuts November oil prices to Asia to 6-year lows
records.boundary: November Asia OSP and observed tanker-rate evidence; not an in-window spot crude settlement or proof that every buyer receives the same delivered-cost reduction.

data_gap_notes: No strictly in-window same-basis Brent/WTI/JKM/TTF/CP/FEI/VLGC instantaneous price set accepted.
No same-window high-quality China LNG/LPG official volume-price update accepted.
